title: Payments
theseInvoicesHaveBeen: These invoices have been approved and are ready for payment. Pay in full or in installments.
noInvoices: No invoices awaiting payment. All verified invoices are fully paid or have active payment requests.
thesePurchaseOrdersWere: These purchase orders were created with an advance or full payment type. Record the advance payment with proof for approval.
noPOs: No POs awaiting advance payment. All advance-type POs are fully paid or have active payment requests.
proofOfPaymentBank: Proof of Payment (bank transfer receipt, cheque, etc.)
thisPaymentIsAlready: This payment is already posted — saving updates the linked voucher, account balances and budget head to match.
thisActionCannotBe: This action cannot be undone. Only payment requests that are not approved or paid can be deleted.
errPayee: Payee and Item are required (format: Payee · Item · Ref)
errAmt: Expense amount must be greater than zero
errReceipt: Receipt must be a PDF or image smaller than 50 MB
noVouchers: No unlinked posted vouchers found for this amount
stdFormat: Standard format: Payee · Item · Ref — no verbs, dates, or amounts in the description.
multiLinkTitle: Link One Voucher to Several Payments
multiLinkNote: Use this when one payment was made for several approved requests (for example four POs to the same vendor). Pick the posted voucher, then tick the requests it covers. Nothing new is posted to the ledgers; the requests are just marked as paid against this voucher.
noUnlinkedVouchers: No unlinked posted payment vouchers found
multiPickRequests: Approved requests covered by this voucher
multiNoRequests: No approved requests are waiting for payment
multiTotals: Selected requests: {{selected}} — Voucher: {{voucher}}. The two must match exactly.
multiLinkDone: Marked as paid — all selected requests are linked to the voucher.
linkNote: The payment of {{v}} was already posted to the ledgers. Select the posted voucher that recorded it — this request will be marked as paid without posting a new voucher (avoids double-entry).
deleteQ: Are you sure you want to delete payment request {{code}}?
